import argparse
import sys


def count(text):
    return {"lines": len(text.splitlines()), "words": len(text.split())}

    ap.add_argument("--words", action="store_true")

    for k in selected:
        print(f"{k} {c[k]}")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
